sources.entry: Yarr - Yarr (yet another rss reader) is a web-based feed aggregator which can be used both as a desktop application and a personal self-hosted server. MIT Go

summary.one_liner: yarr is a web-based RSS/feed aggregator that runs either as a desktop app or as a self-hosted server.
summary.what_it_does: yarr (yet another rss reader) is a web-based feed aggregator. The README says it ships as a single binary with no dependencies and runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It can be used as a desktop application or as a self-hosted personal server. Storage can be SQLite or Postgres. The README is very short and links to external documentation and releases for details on features and setup.
use_cases: read rss feeds in a browser
notable: Ships as a single binary with no dependencies
Works as both a desktop app and a self-hosted server
caveats: README is brief; detailed setup and feature information is in external documentation
Install and run steps are not included in the README
